reviews.text: I liked this but I didn't love it. Nora is interesting as a character -- she's smart and capable and the way she handles the interviews is really satisfying to read. But I never connected with her emotionally. She keeps everything at such a distance that by the end, when the story wants you to feel something about her isolation, I was just kind of... watching. The confession from Voigt about Danny and the cold water was the part that actually got to me. That bit about the sound the body made -- 'like a door closing' -- is going to stay with me.
